text: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
title: Supplication Before Sleeping
benefits: The Prophet, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, always started and ended his day with dhikr.

text: All praise is for Allah who gives us life after He has caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
title: Supplication Upon Waking Up
benefits: By reciting the supplication above, a servant begins his day by praising the name of Allah, the Giver of Life and the Bringer of Death.

text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil and the wicked.
title: Supplication Entering the Bathroom
benefits: This supplication acts as a barrier between a servant's private parts and the jinn when entering the bathroom.

text: I ask for Your forgiveness (O Allah).
title: Supplication Leaving the Bathroom
benefits: The bathroom is one of the homes of the jinn and devils, so it is recommended to ask for forgiveness for any mistakes, intentional or unintentional, made while in the bathroom.

text: In the name of Allah.
title: Supplication Before Eating
benefits: The benefit of reciting Bismillah before eating is to prevent Satan from joining humans in eating.

text: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end.
title: Supplication If Forgetting Bismillah at the Beginning of a Meal
benefits: Islam pays great attention to etiquette. If someone forgets to recite the supplication before eating at the beginning, it is still recommended to recite it in the middle, even if there is only a spoonful of rice left.

text: All praise is to Allah who has fed me this and provided for me without any power or strength from me.
title: Supplication After Eating
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said that if someone recites this supplication, then his past sins will be forgiven.

text: O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.
title: Supplication Entering the Mosque
benefits: The mosque is the house of Allah; a servant should honor it and hope for Allah's mercy within it.

text: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
title: Supplication Leaving the Mosque
benefits: Allah's earth is vast, and there are many ways to seek provision. A servant should ask for Allah's bounty to be facilitated in obtaining the provision that Allah has distributed to all His servants.

text: In the name of Allah.
title: Supplication Before Performing Ablution
benefits: It is prescribed to begin every important matter by saying Bismillah, whether it be an act of worship or otherwise.

text: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves. Glory be to You, O Allah, and with Your praise, I bear witness that there is no deity except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
title: Supplication After Performing Ablution
benefits: Whoever recites this supplication, eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him, and he may enter from whichever gate he wishes.

text: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, Insha Allah.
title: Supplication for Breaking the Fast
benefits: It is highly recommended for those who are fasting to increase their supplications before and after breaking the fast, because the supplication of a fasting person is one of the three supplications that are not rejected.

text: Peace be upon you.
title: Supplication Entering the House #1
benefits: The greeting is a supplication of hope, a hope that you will be safe from all kinds of sorrow and suffering, and be enveloped in mercy and blessings.

text: Peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you.
title: Supplication Entering the House #2
benefits: The greeting is a supplication of hope, a hope that you will be safe from all kinds of sorrow and suffering, and be enveloped in mercy and blessings.

text: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.
title: Supplication Leaving the House
benefits: Whoever recites this supplication, it will be said to him: "You will be guided, sufficed, and protected." Satan will then depart from him. Another satan will say: "How can you harm someone who has been guided, sufficed, and protected?!"

text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, slip or be tripped, wrong or be wronged, or act foolishly or have foolishness done to me.
title: Supplication for Protection from Causing or Experiencing Harm Outside the House
benefits: When a person leaves the house, they will encounter all kinds of things, both good and bad, especially harm caused by themselves. Therefore, it is commanded to seek refuge from oneself and from others.

text: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to Him who has provided this for us, though we could never have had it by our own efforts. Surely to our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety in this journey of ours, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, lighten for us the hardship of this journey and quickly bring us to our destination. O Allah, You are our Companion on the journey and the Guardian of our families. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from a bad return, and from seeing something unpleasant concerning our wealth, family, or children.
title: Travel Supplication
benefits: This supplication has two parts. The first is praise of Allah and the submission of the servant. The second is a request to Allah for ease in travel and in the affairs of what the servant has left at home.

text: I entrust your religion, your trust, and the end of your deeds to Allah.
title: Supplication of a Resident for Someone Who is Traveling
benefits: Three priorities of a servant that must be maintained everywhere: religion, trust, and deeds, because a person will be resurrected according to their deeds.

text: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sins, and ease goodness for you wherever you are.
title: Supplication for Piety from a Resident to Someone Who is Traveling
benefits: Piety is the best provision that a servant must prepare for the Hereafter, because there is no salvation except through piety.

text: O Allah, to You is all praise. You have clothed me with this. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
title: Supplication When Wearing New Clothes
benefits: By reciting this supplication, one asks that the clothes they have bought may provide goodness and also be a protection against various evils.

text: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.
title: Supplication When Wearing Clothes
benefits: The virtue of reciting this supplication is that past sins will be forgiven, Insha Allah.

text: In the name of Allah, in the name of Allah, in the name of Allah. All praise is to Allah. Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done so by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will return. Glory be to You, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
title: Supplication When Mounting a Vehicle
benefits: By reciting the supplication for mounting a vehicle, our journey will always be under the protection of Allah. In addition, we will also receive rewards, help, and a calmer heart.

text: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.
title: Supplication When it Rains
benefits: It is encouraged to pray when it rains so that goodness and blessings increase, as well as its benefits.

text: O Allah, (let the rain fall) around us, not on us. O Allah, (let it fall) on the hills, mountains, small mountains, valleys, and places where trees grow.
title: Supplication During Heavy Rain
benefits: The supplication above is recited when the rain gets heavier or there is a concern that the rain will cause harm.

text: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.
title: Supplication After it Rains
benefits: By reciting this supplication, one believes that rain falls by the will of Allah (Allah's virtue), not by the stars, so they do not become disbelievers in Allah.

text: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this wind, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
title: Supplication During Strong Wind
benefits: Among the signs of Allah's power is a strong wind that can bring blessings and punishment, namely good and bad. Therefore, a servant should continue to ask for good and seek refuge from all harm.

text: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
title: The Best Supplication for Seeking Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar)
benefits: Whoever recites it with certainty in the evening, and then he dies, he will enter Paradise, and likewise if (recited) in the morning.

text: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You wish.
title: Supplication for Ease in All Matters
benefits: Ease comes only from Allah. Even something difficult can become easy Insha Allah.

text: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better.
title: Supplication When Afflicted by Calamity
benefits: A servant should recite the supplication above when afflicted by calamity with certainty and hope. Insha Allah, with this, they will receive a better replacement.

text: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful and keep me away from what is unlawful, and enrich me with Your bounty so I do not depend on anyone besides You.
title: Supplication When in Debt
benefits: Lawful provision, even if it is little, is better than abundant unlawful wealth.

text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, and I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from being overpowered by debt and from being overcome by men.
title: Supplication for Protection from Laziness, Sadness, and Debt
benefits: Abu Umamah then narrated: After I practiced this supplication, Allah truly removed my anxiety and gave me the ability to repay my debt.

text: All praise is to Allah.
title: Supplication After Sneezing
benefits: Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.

text: May Allah have mercy on you.
title: Supplication Upon Hearing Someone Sneeze
benefits: Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.

text: May Allah guide you and improve your condition.
title: Response to Someone Who Says 'Yarhamukallah' After You Sneeze
benefits: Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.

text: O Allah, just as You have made my external form good, make my character good as well.
title: Supplication for Good Character
benefits: A charming appearance is not enough provision for a Muslim, but it must be accompanied by noble character. Therefore, a Muslim should constantly ask for their character to be improved and beautified.

text: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of Satan, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their presence around me.
title: Prayer for Protection from Satan

text: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the wasilah (a high status in Paradise) and the excellence (above all creation), and raise him to the praiseworthy station that You have promised him.
title: Prayer After the Adhan

text: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and all the believers on the Day the account is established.
title: Prayer for Forgiveness for Parents

text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most Hight, the Most Great.
title: Ayatul Kursi

text: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, (1) Allah, the Eternal Refuge. (2) He neither begets nor is born, (3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (4)
title: Al-Ikhlas

text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (1) From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (4) And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (5)
title: Al-Falaq

text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, (1) The King of mankind. (2) The God of mankind, (3) From the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, (4) Who whispers in the breasts of mankind, (5) Of the jinn and mankind." (6)
title: An-Nas

text: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Fire and the punishment of the grave.
title: Upon Entering The Morning by Asking for Protection from Allah

text: O Allah, with Your grace and help we enter the morning, and with Your grace and help we enter the evening. By Your grace and will we live and by Your grace and will we die. And to You is the resurrection (for all creatures).
title: Upon Entering The Morning with The Grace of Allah

text: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I will be true to my covenant and promise to You as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, therefore, forgive me. Indeed, there is no one who can forgive sins except You.
title: Sayyid al-Istighfar

text: O Allah, protect my body (from illness and from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my hearing (from illness and disobedience or from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my sight, there is no deity worthy of worship except You. O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, there is no deity worthy of worship except You.
title: Dua for Protection and Good Health

text: O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in my religion, my world, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my flaws (faults and things that are not appropriate for others to see) and calm me from fear. O Allah, protect me from the front, behind, right, left and above me. I seek refuge in Your greatness, so that I am not snatched from below me (by snakes or swallowed by the earth, etc., which would cause me to fall).
title: Dua for Salvation in The World and Hereafter

text: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of all things and their Sovereign. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, Satan and his soldiers (temptations to commit shirk against Allah), and I (seek refuge in You) from committing evil against myself or dragging it to a Muslim.
title: Dua for Protection from Shaytan Whispers

text: In the name of Allah with Whose name nothing can harm on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
title: Asking for Protection from All Harms

text: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion and Muhammad sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam as my Prophet (sent by Allah).
title: Declaration of Pleasure with Allah, Islam, and the Prophet Muhammad sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam

text: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
title: Asking Allah for Guidance

text: In the morning we are upon the fitrah of Islam, the word of sincerity (the testimony of faith), the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, and the religion of our father Abraham, who stood upon the straight path, a Muslim, and was not among the polytheists.
title: Entering The Morning Upon The Natural Religion of Islam

text: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. And He is over all things competent.
title: Tawheed Dhikr
notes: Recite 1x or 10x in the morning, Recite 100x a day

text: Glory to Allah, I praise Him as many as the number of His creatures, Glory to Allah according to His pleasure, as pure as the weight of His Throne, and as pure as the ink (which writes) His words.
title: Read Tasbih

text: O Allah, I really ask You for knowledge that is beneficial, sustenance that is lawful, and deeds that are accepted.
title: Dua for Useful Knowledge, Good Sustenance, and Accepted Deeds

text: Glory be to Allah, I praise Him.
title: Daily Tasbih and Tahmid

text: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
title: Istighfar 100x a Day

text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
title: Ayat al-Kursi
benefits: Whoever recites this verse in the morning will be protected until the evening. And whoever recites it in the evening will be protected until the morning.

text: Say, "He is Allah , [who is] One, (1) Allah , the Eternal Refuge. (2) He neither begets nor is born, (3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (4)
title: Al-Ikhlas
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (1) From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (4) And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (5)
title: Al-Falaq
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, (1) The King of mankind. (2) The God of mankind, (3) From the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, (4) Who whispers in the breasts of mankind, (5) Of the jinn and mankind." (6)
title: An-Nas
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

text: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Fire and the punishment of the grave.
title: Entering the Evening in the Kingdom of Allah and Seeking His Protection
benefits: Seeking protection from evil is prioritized, the principle that shows the importance of this is: "Preventing harm is more important and prioritized than bringing about good."

text: O Allah, by Your grace and help we have entered the evening, and by Your grace and help we enter the morning. By Your grace and help we live and by Your will we die. And to You is the final return (of all creatures).
title: Entering the Evening by Seeking Allah's Mercy
benefits: Everything we do from morning to evening, from the beginning of our lives until we die, is all under Allah's control and to Him we return.

text: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity worthy of worship except You, You created me and I am Your servant. I will be true to my covenant and promise to You as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, therefore, forgive me. Indeed, there is no one who can forgive sins except You.
title: The Master of Seeking Forgiveness
benefits: Whoever recites it with certainty in the evening, and then he dies, he will enter Paradise, and likewise if (recited) in the morning.

text: O Allah, protect my body (from illness and from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my hearing (from illness and disobedience or from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my sight, there is no deity worthy of worship except You. O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, there is no deity worthy of worship except You.
title: Prayer for Health and Protection
benefits: By asking Allah to grant us well-being in our bodies, we ask to be healed from all physical and spiritual illnesses, so that we have a healthy body and a pure heart, and therefore use this healthy body in a way that pleases Allah.

text: O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in my religion, my world, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my flaws (faults and things that are not appropriate for others to see) and calm me from fear. O Allah, protect me from the front, behind, right, left and above me. I seek refuge in Your greatness, so that I am not snatched from below me (by snakes or swallowed by the earth, etc., which would cause me to fall).
title: Prayer for Safety in This World and the Hereafter
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, never left this supplication in the morning and evening. It contains protection and safety for religion, the world, family, and wealth from various kinds of disturbances that come from all directions.

text: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of all things and their Sovereign. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, Satan and his soldiers (temptations to commit shirk against Allah), and I (seek refuge in You) from committing evil against myself or dragging it to a Muslim.
title: Prayer for Seeking Protection from the Whispers of Satan
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said to Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him, "Say it morning and evening and when you want to sleep."

text: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
title: Remembrance to Be Protected from All Dangers
benefits: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm him.

text: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, as my Prophet.
title: Declaration of Contentment with Allah, Islam, and the Prophet Muhammad sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam
benefits: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, Allah will grant His pleasure to him on the Day of Resurrection.

text: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
title: Asking for Guidance from Allah
benefits: The meaning of this supplication is that humans are in dire need of Allah and pray that Allah does not abandon them even for a moment.

text: In the evening we are upon the fitrah of Islam, the word of sincerity (the testimony of faith), the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, and the religion of our father Abraham, who stood upon the straight path, a Muslim, and was not among the polytheists.
title: Entering the Evening on the Natural Disposition of Islam
benefits: 'Fitratil Islam' means upon the Sunnah, 'kalimatil ikhlas' means the testimony of faith, and 'hanifan' means a heart inclined towards the straight path and goodness.

text: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He is over all things competent.
title: Remembrance of the Oneness of Allah
notes: Read 1x or 10x in the morning, Read 100x daily
benefits: Whoever says this dhikr 100 times a day, it is like freeing 10 slaves, 100 good deeds are recorded for him, 100 mistakes are erased for him, he will be protected from the disturbances of Satan from morning until evening, and no one is better than what he does except someone who practices more than that.

text: Glory be to Allah, as many as His creations, Glory be to Allah as much as His pleasure, Glory be to Allah as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His written words.
title: Reciting Praise to Allah
benefits: The Prophet, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, told Juwairiyah that the dhikr above has surpassed the dhikr recited by Juwairiyah from after Fajr until Dhuha time.

text: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.
title: Daily Praise (Tasbih and Alhamdulillah)
benefits: Whoever says "Subhanallah wa bihamdihi" 100 times in the morning and evening, then nothing will come on the Day of Judgment better than what he has done except one who says the same or more than that.

text: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
title: Seeking Forgiveness 100 Times a Day
benefits: Ibn 'Umar said: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: 'O people, repent to Allah, for indeed I repent to Him one hundred times a day.'

text: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
title: Prayer for Protection from the Evil of Allah's Creation
benefits: Whoever recites it three times in the evening, they will not be afflicted with fever that night.

text: I seek forgiveness from Allah.
title: Istighfar
benefits: When the Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above. Al-Auza'i stated that the recitation of istighfar is 'Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah.'

text: O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.
title: Allah, The Giver of Peace
benefits: When the Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above. Al-Auza'i stated that the recitation of istighfar is 'Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah.'

text: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, there is no preventer of what You give, and no giver of what You withhold, and wealth and honor do not benefit their possessor (except faith and righteous deeds that save from punishment). Only from You is wealth and honor.
title: Allah, The Preventer and The Giver of All Things

text: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. There is no power and no strength except by Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and we do not worship except Him. To Him belongs all favor, grace, and good praise. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, making our religion sincerely for Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
title: Allah, The Possessor of All and The Only One Worthy of Worship
benefits: 'Abdullah bin Zubair said, "The Prophet, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, used to recite the tahlil (laa ilaha illallah) at the end of the prayer."

text: Glory be to Allah
title: Tasbih

text: All praise is for Allah
title: Tahmid

text: Allah is the Greatest
title: Takbir

text: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.
title: There is No Partner for Allah, and To Him Belongs All Things
benefits: Whoever recites the dhikr above, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as numerous as the foam on the ocean. Imam Nawawi, may Allah have mercy on him, said that the text of the hadith indicates that 'Subhanallah', 'Alhamdulillah', and 'Allahu akbar' are each recited 33 times separately.

text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
title: Ayat al-Kursi
benefits: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after finishing the prayer, nothing will prevent him from entering Paradise except death.

text: Say, "He is Allah , [who is] One, (1) Allah , the Eternal Refuge. (2) He neither begets nor is born, (3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (4)
title: Al-Ikhlas
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (1) From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (4) And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (5)
title: Al-Falaq
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, (1) The King of mankind. (2) The God of mankind, (3) From the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, (4) Who whispers in the breasts of mankind, (5) Of the jinn and mankind." (6)
title: An-Nas
benefits: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

text: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
title: Supplication for Beneficial Knowledge, Good Provision, and Accepted Deeds
notes: Read 1x after the salam of Fajr prayer
benefits: Beneficial knowledge is a provision that makes life easier, obtaining good provision is a person's goal in working, and accepted deeds are the hope of every person who performs good deeds. Therefore, a servant should always ask for these 3 things every morning before starting their various activities.

text: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and give us good in the Hereafter, and save us from the torment of the hell fire.
title: Dua Seeking Good In This World And In The Hereafter

text: O Changer of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #1

text: O Allah! Controller of the hearts, direct our hearts to Your obedience.
title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #2

text: O our Lord, do not make our hearts incline to error after You have guided us.
title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #3

text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the loss of the pleasures that You have bestowed, from changes in the health that You have bestowed, from Your sudden torment, and from all Your wrath.
title: Dua To Seek Refuge Against The Loss Of Pleasure

text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from severe calamity, being overtaken by misery, evil destiny, and the triumphant mockery of enemies.
title: Dua To Resist Affliction

text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from care and grief, I seek refuge in You from incapacity and slackness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice and niggardliness, and I seek refuge in You from being overcome by debt and being put in subjection by men.
title: Dua To Be Released From Debt, Anxiety, Weakness, Laziness, Fear, And Pressure from Others

text: Praise be to Allah, by whose grace goodness is perfected.
title: Dua When Getting Good News
